biocontainers.name: pairtools
biocontainers.summary: CLI tools to process mapped Hi-C data

biotools.summary: pairtools is a suite of command-line tools for contact extraction and processing of sequencing data, particularly suited for Hi-C and related chromosome conformation capture protocols. It provides a flexible and high-performance pipeline for analyzing 3C+ data.
